Commentary.Commentary: We are back. The players are out in the middle. Soumya Sarkar and Tanzid Hasan to open for Bangladesh. Saurabh Netravalkar to bowl first.
...THE CHASE...

Except for the openers, the others struggled. Just the one batter scored over 20 and when that happens, one usually ends up with a below par score. Now they will have to bowl really well if they are to defend this. A miracle is needed. Bangladesh should chase this down. Join us for the chase in a bit.

Top effort from Bangladesh and they should win this game from now! USA will be disappointed with their effort especially after the start they got. Their openers began really well but once they fell, it was a procession. The likes of Mustafizur Rahman, Shakib and Rishad Hossain were excellent. The Fizz was the pick with a six-fer but he was well-supported by the rest.
OUT! Six in total for Mustafizur Rahman! Top, top stuff! USA end with 104! Shorter and on middle, this is pulled but to deep mid-wicket where the fielder takes it.

TOSS - Bangladesh have won the toss and ELECTED TO FIELD!

For Bangladesh, this will be morale deflating. Came into the series heavy favourites but have performed really poorly. They should have won both the games but just could hold their nerve in both the encounters. They would be desperate now to avoid a whitewash. Stay tuned for the toss and teams.

If you ever thought it would be USA who would have sealed the series with a game to go, you should go buy yourself a lottery ticket because none of us predicted or thought of this. What a confidence booster this could be for USA heading into the World Cup. Also, the wins they have managed to achieve will just give them the belief that they can win from any position. Can they go better, can they complete the whitewash? Well, we should find out in some time.
